purpose: Place an event after some time or at the end of a developing process.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Before long, the rain turned to snow.
The little seedling will eventually become a large tree.
The voices died away, and eventually the room fell quiet.
restrictions: Can mean before long or eventually; the interval depends on context.
mistake: It does not promise immediate action in the way 直ちに does.
